gloss: to oversee; to supervise; to coordinate

definitions.gloss: to oversee; to supervise; to coordinate; to manage collectively
definitions.explanation: To bring together and manage multiple things, departments, or people as a unified whole. Implies a position of authority over the entire operation.

examples.japanese: {全体|ぜんたい}を{統括|とうかつ}する。
{彼|かれ}は{三|みっ}つの{部門|ぶもん}を{統括|とうかつ}している。
プロジェクト{全体|ぜんたい}を{統括|とうかつ}する{責任者|せきにんしゃ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: We need a person in charge to coordinate the entire project.

notes:
Emphasizes unified management of multiple components from a position of authority. The person who {統括|とうかつ}する is above the individual parts, bringing them together under one direction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全体|ぜんたい}を{統括|とうかつ}する: to oversee the whole
- {部門|ぶもん}を{統括|とうかつ}する: to coordinate departments
- {業務|ぎょうむ}を{統括|とうかつ}する: to manage operations collectively
- {統括|とうかつ}{責任者|せきにんしゃ}: overall supervisor
- {統括|とうかつ}{部長|ぶちょう}: general manager
- {統括|とうかつ}マネージャー: coordinating manager

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {管理|かんり}する: to manage — broader term for day-to-day management and administration
- {総括|そうかつ}する: to summarize / to review — focuses on wrapping up and evaluating, not ongoing management
- {統率|とうそつ}する: to lead / to command — emphasizes leadership of people, often military or team contexts
- {監督|かんとく}する: to supervise / to direct — emphasizes watching over and ensuring quality

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in business and organizational contexts. In casual speech, まとめる is a simpler alternative.
